derivation: Every expectation in this suite is authored from the clause text in the spec above. No expectation was captured from, or verified against, internal/frontier. CF-V0-028 requires exactly this independence.

matrix.matrixRow: CEM 0.1 or OCM bound to 0.1
matrix.requiredResult: `unsupported-frontier-context`, exit 2, no stdout

matrix.matrixRow: CEM 0.1 or OCM bound to 0.1 plus missing expected base or target
matrix.requiredResult: `unsupported-frontier-context`, exit 2, no stdout before revision-required validation

matrix.matrixRow: missing/mismatched expected base or target; forged sidecar
matrix.requiredResult: inherited exact failure, no Frontier result

matrix.matrixRow: partial command/observation/report tuple
matrix.requiredResult: `invalid-frontier-input`

matrix.matrixRow: no dynamic tuple
matrix.requiredResult: static TCQ ID, `testMode: STATIC`

matrix.matrixRow: exact dynamic caller tuple
matrix.requiredResult: dynamic TCQ ID, `DYNAMIC_CALLER_REPORTED`; never test closure

matrix.matrixRow: verified whitespace-only or line-ending-only hunk
matrix.requiredResult: no hunk item

matrix.matrixRow: each CEM unknown reason
matrix.requiredResult: stable item ID and exact mapped reason/action

matrix.matrixRow: one qualifying and one rejected basis
matrix.requiredResult: hunk closes; rejected edge remains in LRF diagnostics

matrix.matrixRow: broad, self-referential, and unrelated bases with no qualifier
matrix.requiredResult: one item; all mapped reasons retained in priority order

matrix.matrixRow: local CEM or OCM `subject-term-bound-exceeded` beside unrelated valid edges
matrix.requiredResult: affected subject remains OPEN with `PROFILE_REQUIRED` / `DEFINE_SUPPORTED_PROFILE`; unrelated results remain available

matrix.matrixRow: supported deletion
matrix.requiredResult: `DELETION_RELATION_REQUIRED`, `PROFILE_REQUIRED`

matrix.matrixRow: OCM unknown
matrix.requiredResult: one intent-change item; no fabricated intent-test item

matrix.matrixRow: linked obligation without material candidate
matrix.requiredResult: `NO_MATERIAL_CHANGE_WITNESS`

matrix.matrixRow: linked obligation with one or more lexical candidates
matrix.requiredResult: one `LEXICAL_CANDIDATE_NONCLOSING` intent-change item containing exactly candidate hunk IDs; never closes

matrix.matrixRow: one hunk shared across obligations
matrix.requiredResult: independent intent-change result per obligation

matrix.matrixRow: empty, skipped, unsupported, unassociated, ambiguous, failed, errored, and unmatched claim
matrix.requiredResult: exact reason union and priority-selected action

matrix.matrixRow: exact passing TCQ caller report
matrix.requiredResult: `CALLER_REPORTED_NONCLOSING`, `AUTHORITY_REQUIRED`, `frontierState: OPEN`

matrix.matrixRow: forged TCQ authority or unknown relation
matrix.requiredResult: upstream canonical rejection

matrix.matrixRow: evidence maps repaired without patch/intent change
matrix.requiredResult: same universe/item IDs; resolved items disappear

matrix.matrixRow: patch or intent identity changed
matrix.requiredResult: new universe and item IDs

matrix.matrixRow: OPEN with empty items, EMPTY with items, or any extra stop-decision field
matrix.requiredResult: `noncanonical-frontier`

matrix.matrixRow: decimal offset beyond the signed 64-bit range
matrix.requiredResult: `noncanonical-frontier`; never wrapped onto a bound value

matrix.matrixRow: aggregate LRF `relevance-bound-exceeded` result
matrix.requiredResult: `frontier-resource-exhausted`; never pass the issue through as an operational code

matrix.matrixRow: caught timeout, `MemoryError`, interruption, unknown upstream code, and uncatchable termination
matrix.requiredResult: exact `CF-V0-022` translation; no output guarantee only for the uncatchable case

matrix.matrixRow: reordered caller arrays and two fresh processes
matrix.requiredResult: byte-identical result

matrix.matrixRow: source, report, command, sibling, and exception canaries
matrix.requiredResult: absent from valid and error output

matrix.matrixRow: every Frontier limit and limit plus one
matrix.requiredResult: complete result versus fail-closed exhaustion

matrix.matrixRow: independent implementation
matrix.requiredResult: byte-identical canonical vectors
